key_points: JP Morgan reiterates a Buy rating and maintains an Overweight stance on FDX, though the price target is kept low
FDX reversed four weeks of losses, supported by praise for its fleet electrification efforts from Ross Gerber
Positive analyst coverage and rating actions improve near‑term sentiment despite modest price target
A comparative UPS vs. FDX article adds market attention but remains neutral
Overall, rating upgrades and positive electrification narrative create a bullish bias for the stock in the coming weeks
